brief: The 6 best fonts for product UI in 2026 — pairing, performance, and licenses.

slots.body: The open-source default for dashboards. Excellent legibility at small sizes and a huge variable weight range.
slots.tileValue: Use for headlines to add organic contrast to Inter's neutrality.

slots.body: Vercel's precise, technical sans built for dark mode and dense developer interfaces with superb performance.
slots.tileValue: Variable file is only 90 KB and supports Latin glyphs.

slots.body: A modern geometric sans with gently rounded corners. Free, open-source and performs flawlessly on mobile screens.
slots.tileValue: Thin through ExtraBold gives you full control without loading another family.

slots.body: Distinctive angular cuts and generous spacing make numbers and data tables incredibly easy to scan quickly.
slots.tileValue: Default tracking is wide; tighten to -2% for dense admin panels.

slots.body: Google's refined neo-grotesque offers an optical-size axis that auto-tunes letterforms for tiny captions and giant heroes.
slots.tileValue: Turn on optical sizing in CSS for crisp text below 14 px.

slots.body: A powerful industrial sans with true italics. Ideal for SaaS brands that need personality without sacrificing readability.
slots.tileValue: The italic is not merely slanted; redrawn strokes add real emphasis.

slots.tagline: Clear, practical design tips for product teams who care about craft.
